summary.text: Bill Kaiser is the Republican candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 76, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Kaiser described himself as a U.S. Army veteran who owned an HVAC and construction business for 16 years.

paragraphs.text: Bill Kaiser said in the survey that he has more than 35 years of experience in construction and HVAC, and that he owned All Weather Mechanical, Inc., a small business serving local families, for 16 years.
He said he worked to launch a Victory Garden during the 2020 shutdowns to support more than 20 families with food.

Kaiser listed three campaign messages: local control and property rights over Lansing mandates; support for small businesses and the trades and keeping taxes low; and defending personal freedom, faith, safe communities and strong schools.
